column1: # Recipe pack: Forge 1.20.x -> NeoForge 1.21.1 (issue #27, Stage 4). Format: tools/apply-recipes.py.
# so Forge packages already read net.neoforged.* here. Every row is a catalogue entry's own Pattern -> Fix;
# replacements that need an import are written fully qualified inline (§V19), so no import block is edited.
# A member rename names its owner (§X7). Order matters within the regex rows (§X4): they run in file order,
#@ 24 auto  ForgeEventFactory / ForgeHooks / ForgeHooksClient became EventHooks / CommonHooks / ClientHooks
#@ 45 auto  the FORGE event bus is the GAME bus
#@ 11 auto  ForgeRegistries.X is BuiltInRegistries.X (singular); lookups are get, not getValue
#@ 46 auto  defaultDurability is durability; Properties.copy is ofFullCopy
#@ 98 auto  getDimensions is final; override getDefaultDimensions
#@ 32 auto  hurtAndBreak takes the slot, not a break callback
#@ 113 auto  setMaxUpStep is the STEP_HEIGHT attribute
#@ 36 auto  ForgeMod reach attributes are vanilla
#@ 138 auto  GeckoLib 4.8 flattened the core packages
#@ 20 manual  TickEvent phases -> PlayerTickEvent.Post / ServerTickEvent / LevelTickEvent
#@ 30 manual  MobType is gone: entity-type tags, or a local compat shim
